rationale: The Latin anchor *buccella* means a small morsel or bite-sized piece of bread broken off, directly corresponding to fragment.n.01 ("a piece broken off or cut off of something else"). The broader context *manducaverunt panem* ("they ate bread") confirms a concrete, physical piece of food rather than an incomplete artifact (shard.n.01) or an incomplete textual/abstract fragment (fragment.n.03).
